title: The Object QML Collected: Who Owns What a C++ Function Hands to JavaScript
fallback: This lesson is about who deletes an object that was given to QML, so it needs Qt. Lesson 09-04 is the same question for QObject parents in plain Qt Core, and lesson 02-01 for unique_ptr in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a pool that owns the objects it hands to QML, so that the garbage collector never deletes them
